visual.name: bfusionKpiTicker
visual.description: A single-line KPI ticker: bind any number of measures and they scroll continuously across the bar, each with its field name as the label and an optional status dot. Pauses on hover and on keyboard focus, and holds still for viewers who ask for reduced motion. Built for portfolio header bands.

dataRoles.name: dimension
dataRoles.description: Optional. Portfolio, Programme, Project or any other grouping. Each member produces its own set of ticker items, compared against that member's previous period.

dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: Optional. A month or date field. When bound, the ticker shows the latest period in context and compares each measure against the period before it. An explicit Compare to measure still wins where one is bound.

dataRoles.name: values
dataRoles.description: The measures to scroll. Each measure becomes one item in the ticker: its field name is the label, its value is the figure. Order here is the order they appear.

dataRoles.name: comparison
dataRoles.description: Optional. The prior-period or target value for each measure, matched to Measures in order (first here to first there). Drives the trend arrow: current minus comparison.

dataRoles.name: status
dataRoles.description: Optional. Drives the coloured dot in front of an item, matched to Measures in order (first Status to first Measure, and so on). Text values matching On Track / Healthy → green; At Risk / Watch / Amber → amber; Off Track / Critical / Overdue → red. Numbers use their sign: positive → green, zero → amber, negative → red.

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, panels, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

alwaysScroll.description: On: the ticker keeps moving even when the items already fit, repeating them to fill the bar. Off: it holds still unless the content overflows.

flatThreshold.description: A change smaller than this counts as flat and shows the watch colour instead of good or critical.

polarity.description: Whether a rise is good or bad. Set the default here, then override it per measure below.

enumeration.value: Segoe UI, wf_segoe-ui_normal, helvetica, arial, sans-serif

backgroundTransparency.description: 0 is solid, 100 lets the report page show through.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
